title: Meal count assistants, adult supervisors, and classroom cleaners; minimum wage.
bodyText: Except as provided in section 387-9, the wages of meal count assistants, adult supervisors, and classroom cleaners of the department shall be no less than the current state minimum wage as required in section 387-2.
bodyHtml: [§302A-641]  Meal count assistants, adult supervisors, and classroom cleaners; minimum wage.  Except as provided in section 387-9, the wages of meal count assistants, adult supervisors, and classroom cleaners of the department shall be no less than the current state minimum wage as required in section 387-2. [L 2005, c 191, §1]
